annotations.title: Find broadband deals at an address

description: Returns the broadband deals available at a UK address or postcode: a best value, cheapest and fastest pick plus a provider-varied list. Each deal has its monthly price, contract length, speed and true whole-contract cost, with intro pricing, later price rises and setup fees included. Optional filters: budget, minimum speed, provider, contract length, no mid-contract rises, mobile and satellite broadband. The precision field says whether results are for one property or the whole postcode.

address_label.description: The display_address the user picked from search_addresses, passed back verbatim. Carried into the switch link so the FindBroadband site greets the user with their address instead of asking again.

exclude_mid_contract_rises.description: true when the user says they want no mid-contract price rises.

include_mobile_broadband.description: Include 4G/5G home broadband and fixed wireless. Default false: deals on a line only.

include_satellite.description: Include satellite broadband (Starlink). Default false. Satellite needs a dish and has an upfront cost.

max_contract_months.description: Longest contract the user will accept, e.g. 12 for 'no long contracts'.

max_monthly_price.description: Budget cap in GBP per month, from phrases like 'under £30'.

min_speed_mbps.description: Minimum download speed in Mbps. Typical needs: email and browsing about 35, two people working from home plus gaming about 150, a heavy 4K household about 300.

provider.description: Only show deals from this provider, when the user names one.

uprn.description: Property identifier (UPRN) from search_addresses. With it, results are for that exact property instead of the whole postcode. An internal reference, not meaningful to the user.

name: find_broadband_deals

gift.description: Provider incentive shown on the deal card: a gift card / reward, or a switching credit. NOT included in any cost figure. A switching credit (e.g. 'up to £300') only offsets early-termination fees owed to the user's CURRENT provider, so it is worth £0 to someone out of contract. Gift cards are real value but not bill money.

upload_mbps.description: Advertised upload. Left out for satellite (Starlink), whose feed figure is wrong: Ofcom reports Starlink averages about 20 Mbps up.

title: Find broadband deals at an address
